# Birko.Data.SQL.Views

<!-- spec-links: generated by Birko.Framework/spec-links.cs from docs/specs/.map.yml. Do not edit: change the map and run `dotnet run spec-links.cs`. -->
**Specs**: [views-and-aggregation](../Birko.Framework/docs/specs/views-and-aggregation.md)
<!-- /spec-links -->

SQL platform implementation for Birko.Data.Views. Translates ViewDefinition into SQL Tables.View metadata and reuses existing connector infrastructure for query execution and DDL.

## Components

- **SqlViewTranslator** — Refuses a nested source (`r.Sub.X`, `NotSupportedException` naming it, TASK-843): a table has a column only per top-level property, and it used to read the top-level column of the last name. Converts ViewDefinition → Tables.View by loading source tables via DataBase.LoadTable, mapping fields, creating FunctionFields for aggregates (via `FunctionField.CreateFunctionField()` and `AbstractConnectorBase.GetSqlFunctionName()`), and building Join conditions. A `Count<TSource>()` without a source counts the primary key (else the first NOT NULL column): it counted the first declared column, so a group holding NULL there counted 0 (TASK-887). An aggregate renders through the provider's `SqlValueFragmentDialect.Aggregate` (SELECT, persistent DDL and on-the-fly ORDER BY alike) and reads through `AggregateValue.Convert`, shared with the store's `Aggregate` (TASK-892): SUM over only NULLs is 0, SQLite's decimal SUM / AVG are exact and collated, a decimal AVG (or one into a decimal) is refused on the servers — see README § Aggregates
- **SqlViewStore\<TView\>** — Implements IViewStore\<TView\> using existing connector SelectView/Select infrastructure
- **SqlViewManager** — Implements IViewManager using connector CreateView/DropView/ViewExists

## Dependencies
- Birko.Data.Views (ViewDefinition, IViewStore, IViewManager)
- Birko.Data.SQL (DataBase, AbstractConnector, Tables, Fields, Conditions)
- Birko.Data.SQL.View (Tables.View, ViewQueryMode, FunctionField)
